briefing.summary: An enterprise marketing automation platform sending billions of personalised messages a month — email, SMS, push, WhatsApp. Java and Spring on the back, React and TypeScript on the front, MySQL underneath, and the interesting problems are all about scale: deduplicating, counting and aggregating enormous volumes without falling over. The posting also asks for a subject matter expert who mentors, reviews code properly and owns their services in production. Half the questions here are about that half of the job.
requirements: 5+ years building web applications: JavaScript/TypeScript with React, Java with Spring
Relational persistence — MySQL — and the query performance that comes with it
Distributed systems: ingest, deduplicate, count, aggregate, archive at scale
Operational ownership — monitoring, troubleshooting, performance and security
High-quality code review and mentoring junior engineers
Agile delivery, TDD and pair programming
Communicating trade-offs to stakeholders across time zones
